conbody.p: In addition to proper inflation, correct wheel alignment helps to decrease tire wear. If you find a tire is worn unevenly, have the wheel alignment inspected by a professional workshop. Kia recommends visiting an authorized Kia dealer or service partner.

When you have new tires installed, make sure they are balanced. This will increase vehicle ride comfort and tire life. Additionally, a tire should always be rebalanced if it is removed from the wheel.
